items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: But I worked with him for a pretty good while, I guess for about a year or so.

ctx.x: That's a funny thing. Did this world of the Verney play kind of anything like you play it now?

Well, I'll tell you the truth. I never did. I ain't never even hoid him to play with a man. Mm-hmm. I never hoid him to play. I couldn't tell you that. Where were you brought up anyway? Here in the city. Well, we'll start the beginning. Where were you falling exactly? I was falling right down here in the Sempern Hall. Ellen and Priya. Ellen and Priya? It's not far from him. And where have you lived? Did you say that most of your life? No. Well, I don't remember that address. But the next place that I remember was…

Reel 2, Albert Burbank, January the 4th, 1962. You say you will work with many bands, huh? Yeah. Such as? Such as Buddy P.T., Kid Thomas. When did you work with Thomas? Well, that's way back, but I just can't remember. Before the break and after? Why do you remember? I don't remember if it was before or after. But I worked with him for a pretty good while, I guess for about a year or so. He did. I didn't know that. He's waiting across the room. He had a job on weekends. I played with Buddy P.T. for a good while.…
